## Verification Checklist

- [ ] SQL was tested against the documented MySQL teaching baseline.
- [ ] Queries use clear formatting and meaningful aliases.
- [ ] Production-style examples avoid unnecessary `SELECT *`.
- [ ] Application-facing SQL is parameterized where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, real personal data, or confidential organizational data are included.
- [ ] Destructive SQL includes clear warnings or safe transaction guidance.
- [ ] Security, privacy, performance, and migration impacts were reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation, references, and changelog were updated where necessary.
- [ ] The change does not duplicate an existing source of truth.
- [ ] The contribution is compatible with the MIT License.
